title: Baobab Topology Domain Vocabulary (ADR-BCP-025)
description:
Grammars and closed vocabularies for engine releases, artifact identity and deployment observation (ADR-BCP-025, gate ER-01). The identifiers the Control Plane mints (engineReleaseId, deploymentObservationId) live in control-plane/v1/domain.schema.json with the other topology identifiers (ADR-SHARED-012).

Control Plane is the runtime authority. Shared is the contract authority.

releaseVersion.description: The engine's semantic version, MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with an optional pre-release (section 2.1). No build metadata: two builds of one version are one release or a conflict (RELEASE_VERSION_CONFLICT), never two releases. Never a mutable tag such as latest.

releaseStatus.description: EngineRelease lifecycle (section 2.4, release-policy.yaml status_transitions). APPROVED means the release may be named as a desired release; it is not certification (amendment A3). REVOKED is terminal. A closed set, so it is safe as a bounded metric label.

artifactType.description: The kind of artifact (section 2.2). Other types are added by a Shared contract change only.

artifactDigest.description: The artifact's content digest: sha256: followed by 64 lowercase hex characters. This is the artifact's identity (section 2.2). A digest belongs to at most one release of one engine.

artifactRepository.description: Where the artifact is published, e.g. ghcr.io/baobab-platform/baobab-trade. A location, never an identity: it carries no tag and no digest, and is never compared to decide which release is running.

artifactPlatform.description: OCI platform of one artifact in a multi-platform release, e.g. linux/amd64 or linux/arm64/v8.

displayTag.description: A tag recorded for readability only (section 2.2). It is never compared, resolved or trusted.

sourceRevision.description: The full 40-hex git commit SHA a release was built from. Never a branch or tag name.

declarationDigest.description: sha256 over the exact bytes of the engine repository's .baobab/capability-provider.yaml at the release's source_revision (section 2.1.3, amendment A2).

contractMajorVersion.description: The canonical representation of a capability contract version: the contract's major version, a positive integer (section 2.1.1). Minor and patch versions are backward compatible by the capability contract rules, so they never decide compatibility. Stored values such as v1, 1 or 1.x.y normalise to 1; a value that cannot be normalised is a data defect, reported and never guessed. capability/v1 contract_versions and required_contract_version already use this form.

deploymentRegion.description: The deployment region an engine instance runs in, as the Control Plane records it for the instance, e.g. eu-west-1.

observedReleaseState.description: What the Control Plane derives from an instance's current observation (section 2.6). RELEASE: every observed digest belongs to one release of the instance's engine. UNKNOWN_ARTIFACT: a digest belongs to no recorded release. FOREIGN_ARTIFACT: a digest belongs to another engine's release. MIXED: the digests span several releases of the instance's engine. UNKNOWN: no current observation (none, expired or future-dated). A closed set, so it is safe as a bounded metric label.

releaseDriftReason.description: Why an ENGINE_INSTANCE_RELEASE drift exists (section 2.7). Each is registered in the release_drift category of authorization/v1/reason-code-registry.yaml, and release-policy.yaml gives each its severity and grace period. A MIXED observation held past the rollout window is RELEASE_MISMATCH: the instance is not running its desired release. A closed set, so it is safe as a bounded metric label.

engineReleaseReasonCode.description: A code registered in the engine_release category of authorization/v1/reason-code-registry.yaml: why the Control Plane refused to record a release, change its status, set a desired release or accept a deployment observation.

topologyMetric.description: ADR-BCP-025 section 2.10 metric names, in Prometheus form. engine_instance_release_total counts instances by the status of their observed release (or the observed state when there is no single release); engine_instance_release_drift_total counts instances with open release drift by reason; deployment_observation_age_seconds is the age of each instance's current observation; deployment_observation_rejected_total counts refused observations; engine_release_total counts recorded releases by status.

topologyMetricLabel.description: The only label names topology metrics may carry. Each takes values from a closed contract vocabulary: releaseStatus, observedReleaseState, releaseDriftReason, control-plane/v1 environment, and the engine_release reason codes. No digest, version, release, engine instance or tenant is ever a label (section 2.10).
